title: 第 18 章 不逞一时之快谋定而后动第 17 章 伪善嘴脸被我尽收眼底
lines: 收到系统预警的瞬间，陆衍立刻拉着赵小胖躲进路边浓密灌木丛，目光隔着密林望向黑风幽谷的断崖方向。苏已经察觉到侧面山路存在隐患，半个时辰之内就要抽调半数埋伏人手赶去布防，一旦对方防线落地，整片幽谷四面八方全被锁死，再想悄无声息靠近灵草水潭难如登天。眼下半个时辰就是唯一的黄金窗口期，错过这次，至少还要再等三日灵草药效才不会损耗，可三日后宗门小试炼准时开启，苏转头全身心扑在试炼夺宝上，灵草看守只会更加严密。
赵胖急得搓手转圈，圆脸上满是焦急：“少爷要不咱们直接冲！趁着他们人手还没调过来，抢先摸进水潭摘了灵草就撤，大不了遇上看守的人咱们凭修为硬闯出去！”在小胖的固有思维里，想要拿宝物最直接的办法就是动手硬碰，可陆衍直接摇头否决。
“贸然正面冲突，出手伤了苏的手下，立马触犯系统惩罚条款，扣除功德、加重天道厄运，反倒正中苏的圈套。对方巴不得我冲动动手，抓住伤人把柄上报宗门，当场扣上劫掠伤人的重罪，借着律法把我治罪，顺势再收割一大波同情气运。”经过一次次和天命之子交手，陆衍早就摸透对方全套陷阱逻辑，但凡能引诱自己暴怒施暴，苏永远是最大赢家。
他快速在脑海梳理完整行动方案，不走强攻路线，继续沿用卡地形、借天时、利用阵法规则的稳妥打法。苏所有布防重心全都放在谷口正门和地底暗渠两处关键点位，断崖是临时补防，人员调动还需要赶路时间，半空山岩之上有一处天然石缝，顺着石缝能够直通水潭上方崖顶，这条小路荒僻陡峭，苏压根没有在情报里标注，自然没有安排任何看守。
“咱们分两头行动，你立刻折返宗门，继续盯着苏留在城内的跟班，把新一轮造谣的人证、话语全部记录在册，收集齐全舆论黑料；我借着半个时辰的空档，从崖顶石缝潜入，只摘灵草、不与人发生任何肢体冲突，完事悄然原路撤离。”陆衍快速下达分工，赵小胖虽然放心不下少爷孤身进山，但也清楚留下来只会拖累潜行节奏，再三叮嘱注意安全之后，转头快步赶回青玄宗城内搜集证据。
目送小胖走远，陆衍紧了紧身上深色夜行衣，借着林间草木掩护，快步绕向断崖山壁。一路上零星碎石被狂风卷着砸来，残留的微量天道厄运还在暗中作祟，不过连日行善积攒的功德金光环绕周身，飞来石块在靠近身躯半尺处自动偏移落地，所有小阻碍全都被功德之力轻松化解。没用一刻钟，陆衍就爬到半山天然石缝入口，石缝狭窄，刚好能容一人侧身通行，内壁长满滑腻青苔，隐蔽性拉绝，从谷底根本发现不了崖上的入口。

钻进石缝一路向下缓步挪动，约莫一炷香时间，陆悄无声息落到灵潭上方的巨型崖石背面，藏身浓密藤蔓之后向下俯瞰。此刻水潭边，苏正盘膝打坐吸收灵草散逸的稀薄灵气，两名留守护卫守在潭边两侧，剩下一半人手已经动身赶往断崖赶路，谷内防备出现短暂真空。百年凝气灵扎根在水中央青石缝隙，翠绿色叶片伴着潭水雾气微微晃动，浓郁药香随风飘散，距离彻底成熟还差一个时辰，现在采摘药力已经完全达标，提前摘取也不会出现药效流失的问题。
陆没有急着立刻动手，继续耐心蛰伏观察。苏打坐间隙时不时开口呵斥身旁两名护卫，嫌两人站姿散漫、做事粗心，随口克扣原本许诺的修炼丹药，先前答应的酬劳全数作废。两名护卫满心憋屈却不敢反驳，只能低头默默受气，这些刻薄举动又被陆一一记在随身玉简，新增一条苏虚伪实证。人前仗义大方体恤手下，人后吝啬刻薄随意毁约，苏的两面派嘴脸暴露无遗。
又过片刻，前去断崖布防的手下传来传讯玉简，禀报已经抵达山路、正在挖坑埋设警戒符文。苏看完传讯方才放下心头大石，起身伸了个懒腰，叮嘱两人死守潭边，自己转身去往谷中木屋准备晚饭，打算等夜里灵草完全熟透再正式采摘。
苏一走，潭边两名护卫渐渐放松警惕，靠着青石闲聊扯皮，压根没留意头顶崖石藏着外人。陆抓住绝佳空隙，指尖凝聚一缕轻柔灵气，隔着数丈距离精准探出，顺着水面缓缓包裹灵草根茎，不碰水纹、不发出半点响动，靠着灵气牵引一点点把百年凝气灵连根拔出水面，完整收入储物袋。全程没有半点灵气波动，没有惊动下方两名护卫，灵草顺利到手。
到手之后陆没有多做停留，顺着来时石缝原路折返，等苏吃过晚饭回到水潭，一眼看见水潭中空空如也，灵草消失不见，瞬间面色煞白，慌忙带着两名护卫满山搜查，从谷口查到暗渠、又冲到刚布好的断崖防线，整片幽谷翻了个底朝天，从头到尾找不到半点人为闯入的痕迹，阵法、警戒符文全部完好无损，灵草凭空消失，又是一口哑巴亏憋在心里，连告状的凭据都拿不出来。
陆衍已经顺着山路安然撤出黑风幽谷，走在返回宗门的林间小道上，脑海里系统提示音接连响起。【叮！宿主合规截取苏依靠天命独占的不义灵草，全程不伤一人、不毁一物，坚守良心底线，触发初级良心暴击！】【功德+520，修为小幅精进，天道压制再度下降7%，【微末气运制衡】被动效果再次增强。】
海量细碎灵气顺着周身毛孔涌入体内，炼气巅峰的根基越发浑厚，距离突破筑基的门槛越来越近。
刚回到陆家宅院，赵小胖已经抱着厚厚的笔录册子等候多时，把这大半天搜集的造谣证据全数上交：“少爷，苏手下遍布内门外各个角落，全天不间断散播谣言，到处说您用阴术盗走幽谷先天灵草，不少不明真相的弟子已经信以为真，又开始跟风谩骂。”
陆翻看笔录淡淡一笑，现在的造谣依旧在天道操控的常规套路里，苏拿不出实质证据，只能靠舆论泼脏水，等到宗门小比的公开大舞台，所有证据一次性甩出就能完成舆论大反转。
可还没等两人细算收获，周伯脚步匆匆跑进院子，带来重磅消息：宗门高层正式敲定小比详细赛程，苏暗中买通大半裁判，赛前私下送礼许诺好处，已经提前设好比武陷阱，预备在擂台之上借裁判之手故意判罚，只要陆登台比试，随便一个动作就能被扣恶意伤人的罪名，当众废掉名次、踩烂名声。

The moment he received the system warning, Lu Yan immediately pulled Zhao Xiaopang and hid in the thick bushes on the roadside, looking through the dense forest towards the cliff of Black Wind Valley. Su had already noticed that there were hidden dangers on the side mountain road, and within half an hour he would dispatch half of the ambush men to set up defenses. Once the enemy's defense line fell, the entire valley would be locked from all directions, and it would be extremely difficult to approach the Lingcao Pool quietly. The current half hour is the only golden window. If you miss this time, you will have to wait at least three more days for the spiritual herb to take effect before it is lost. However, in three days, the sect's small trial will start on time. Su turned his head and devoted himself to the trial to win the treasure, and the spiritual herb will only be guarded even more tightly.
Fatty Zhao rubbed his hands in circles in a hurry, his round face full of anxiety: "Master, why don't we just rush in! Before their manpower can be mobilized, we rush into the pool to pick the spiritual herbs and then retreat. If we encounter the guards, we will force our way out with our cultivation!" In Fatty's inherent thinking, the most direct way to get the treasure is to hit it head-on, but Lu Yan shook his head and objected.
"I had a head-on conflict and injured one of Su's men. I immediately violated the system's punishment provisions, deducted merit, and aggravated the fate of heaven. Instead, I fell into Su's trap. The other party was eager for me to act impulsively, seize the reason for the injury, report it to the sect, and arrest him for robbery on the spot. It's a serious crime to hurt others. Use the law to punish me and harvest a wave of sympathy and luck." After fighting against the Son of Destiny again and again, Lu Yan had already figured out the opponent's complete trap logic. As long as he could be tempted to become angry and violent, Su would always be the biggest winner.
He quickly sorted out the complete action plan in his mind, and instead of taking the offensive route, he continued to use the safe play method of blocking the terrain, taking advantage of the weather, and making use of the rules of the formation. All of Su's defense focus was placed on the two key points of the valley entrance and the underground culvert. The cliff was a temporary defense, and it would take time to move personnel. There was a natural stone crevice on the mid-air mountain rock, and one could follow the stone crevice directly to the top of the cliff above the water pool. This path was remote and steep, and Su had not marked it in the intelligence at all, so naturally no guards were arranged.
"We will act in two directions. You immediately return to the sect, continue to keep an eye on Su's followers in the city, record all the witnesses and words of the new round of rumors, and collect all the public opinion materials; I took advantage of half an hour to sneak in through the cracks on the top of the cliff, only picking spiritual herbs and not talking to anyone. If there is any physical conflict, quietly evacuate the same way." Lu Yan quickly ordered the division of labor. Although Zhao Xiaopang was worried about the young master going into the mountain alone, he also knew that staying would only slow down the stealth rhythm. After repeatedly warning him to pay attention to safety, he turned around and hurried back to Qingxuanzong City to collect evidence.
Watching Xiaopang walk away, Lu Yan tightened his dark night clothes and quickly walked around the cliff using the cover of vegetation in the forest. Scattered rocks were thrown by the strong wind along the way, and the remaining traces of heavenly misfortune were still secretly at work. However, the golden light of merit accumulated by doing good deeds in the past few days surrounded the body, and the flying rocks automatically deflected and landed half a foot away from the body. All small obstacles were easily resolved by the power of merit. In less than a quarter of an hour, Lu Yan climbed to the entrance of the natural stone crevice in the middle of the mountain. The stone crevice was narrow, just big enough for a person to pass sideways. The inner wall was covered with slippery moss, making it completely invisible. The entrance to the cliff could not be discovered from the bottom of the valley.
Lu got into the cracks in the rocks and moved slowly downwards. After about a stick of incense, Lu quietly landed on the back of the giant cliff above the Lingtan. He hid in the thick vines and looked down. At this moment, by the pool, Su was sitting cross-legged, meditating and absorbing the thin spiritual energy escaping from the spiritual grass. The two remaining guards were guarding both sides of the pool. The remaining half of the men had already set off to rush to the cliff. There was a brief vacuum in the valley's defenses. The century-old Qi Ningling spirit is rooted in the cracks of the bluestone in the middle of the water. The emerald green leaves are swaying slightly with the mist of the pool water, and the strong medicinal fragrance is drifting in the wind. It is still an hour away from being fully mature. Now the medicinal power has fully reached the standard, and there will be no problem of loss of medicinal efficacy if picked early.
Lu was not in a hurry to take action immediately and continued to wait patiently and observe. Su Su scolded the two guards beside him from time to time while he was sitting. He thought they were standing sloppily and carelessly, so they casually deducted the promised cultivation elixirs, and all the previously promised rewards were voided. The two guards were aggrieved but did not dare to refute, they could only bow their heads and accept the anger silently. These mean actions were recorded by Lu Yiyi on the jade slips he carried with him, adding a new piece of evidence of Su's hypocrisy. In front of others, he is generous and considerate to his subordinates, but behind the scenes, he is stingy, mean and breaks contracts at will. Su's double-faced character is fully exposed.
After a while, the men who went to the cliff to set up defenses received a jade slip, reporting that they had arrived at the mountain road and were digging holes to bury warning runes. After reading the message, Su felt relieved. He stood up, stretched, and told the two of them to stay by the pond. He turned around and went to the wooden house in the valley to prepare dinner. He planned to wait until the spiritual grass was fully ripe at night before officially picking it.
As soon as Su left, the two guards by the pool gradually relaxed their vigilance and chatted and gossiped against the bluestone. They didn't even notice that there were outsiders hiding in the cliff above their heads. Lu seized the perfect gap, condensed a wisp of gentle spiritual energy on his fingertips, and accurately detected it from a distance of several feet. He slowly wrapped the root of the spiritual grass along the water surface without touching the water or making any sound. He relied on the spiritual energy to pull out the century-old energy condensing spirit from the water little by little, and put it completely into the storage bag. There was no spiritual energy fluctuation during the entire process, and the spiritual grass was successfully obtained without alerting the two guards below.
After he got it, Lu didn't stop much, and turned back along the way he came from through the cracks in the rocks. When Su returned to the water pool after dinner, he saw that the water pool was empty and the spiritual grass had disappeared. His face turned pale in an instant. He hurriedly led two guards to search the mountain. They checked the culvert from the mouth of the valley, and then rushed Arriving at the newly deployed cliff defense line, the entire valley was turned upside down. There was no trace of human intrusion from beginning to end. The formations and warning runes were all intact. The spiritual grass disappeared out of thin air. I felt dumb again and couldn't even produce evidence to complain.
Lu Yan had safely evacuated from the Black Wind Valley along the mountain road and was walking on the forest path back to the sect. System notifications sounded in his mind one after another. 【bite! The host complied with the law and intercepted the unjust spiritual grass that Su relied on his destiny to monopolize. No one was hurt or anything was destroyed in the whole process. He adhered to the bottom line of conscience and triggered a low-level conscience critical attack! 】【Merit +520, cultivation has improved slightly, Heavenly Suppression has dropped again by 7%, and the passive effect of [Micro Luck Control and Balance] has been enhanced again. 】
A large amount of fine spiritual energy pours into the body along the pores all over the body. The foundation of the peak of Qi refining becomes thicker and thicker, and the threshold of breaking through the foundation building is getting closer and closer.
Having just returned to the Lu Family Mansion, Zhao Xiaopang had been waiting for a long time with a thick book of records and handed over all the rumor-mongering evidence that he had collected for a long time: "Master, Su's men are all over the inner and outer gates, spreading rumors all day long, saying that you used Yin magic to steal the innate spiritual grass of the valley. Many disciples who don't know the truth have believed it, and started to follow the trend and curse."
Lu Fan looked at the transcript and smiled lightly. The current rumors were still in the routine of Tiandao control. Su could not provide any substantial evidence and could only rely on public opinion to throw dirty water. When the sect's competition was held on the public stage, all the evidence could be thrown out at once to complete the reversal of public opinion.
But before the two of them could calculate their gains, Zhou Bo hurried into the courtyard and brought heavy news: the sect's senior officials had officially finalized the detailed schedule of the competition. Su had secretly bribed most of the referees and gave them private gifts and promised benefits before the competition. He had already set up a competition trap in advance and was prepared to use the hands of the referees to make deliberate penalties on the ring. As long as Lu entered the stage to compete, any move he made could be accused of malicious wounding, and his ranking would be revoked in public, and his reputation would be ruined.
